resale_co.name: Certificate of Inspection (COI) / Certificate of Continued Occupancy, with Zoning Permit
resale_co.lead_time: Contact the Building Department at least 7 days before closing to schedule the inspections and correct any issues.
requirements: Portable fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen (Fire Prevention page still lists it)
resale_co.how_to_apply: Contact the Building Department (227 Phillips Ave., (201) 440-1815 x106) at least 7 days before closing to apply for the Zoning Permit, the smoke and carbon monoxide inspection and the Certificate of Inspection. Inspections are by appointment; permit submittal hours are Monday to Friday 9:00am to 4:00pm.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official (Zoning Officer: Raymond DeRiso, ZoningOfficer@southhackensacknj.org)

evidence.quote: If you are selling a home in South Hackensack a Zoning Permit, Smoke & Carbon Monoxide inspection, and Certificate of Inspection (COI) are all required prior to closing.
Please contact the Building Department at least 7 days prior to your closing.
Residents planning to sell homes are required to apply and receive a Certificate of Continued Occupancy from the Building Department.
Issue Certificates of Continued Occupancy for resale of all properties

resale_co.notes: The Building Department's 'Property Sale: Certificate of Inspection' page lists the three items needed before closing (Zoning Permit, smoke/CO inspection and Certificate of Inspection) and their fees. The Fire Prevention page calls the same thing a Certificate of Continued Occupancy. Zoning permit fee depends on whether the home is owner occupied. No downloadable application or validity period is posted. Staff names come from the Building Department page; the Construction Official email is the generic BuildingOfficial@ address shown there.

requirements: At least one smoke detector on every floor including the basement
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of all bedroom doors
Portable fire extinguisher within 10 feet of the kitchen, hung no higher than 5 feet, rated ABC, 2.5 to 10 lbs (page still lists it)

authorities.name: South Hackensack Building Department with the South Hackensack Fire Prevention Bureau
authorities.lead_time: Contact the Building Department at least 7 days before closing.

fees.label: Smoke and carbon monoxide detector inspection

authorities.how_to_apply: Request the smoke and carbon monoxide inspection through the Building Department as part of the resale package (Fire Prevention Bureau performs home-sale smoke/CO/extinguisher inspections).

evidence.quote: This requires an inspection for smoke detectors, carbon monoxide alarms, and fire extinguishers.
Inspect all homes for sale to ensure smoke detectors, carbon monoxide alarms, and fire extinguishers are installed and operating
Fire Official Fredrick J Dressel IV

fire_cert.notes: The township lists a flat $25 smoke and carbon monoxide inspection fee; no tiered short-notice fees are posted. The Fire Prevention pages still list a portable fire extinguisher, which P.L.2025, c.19 removed from the sale certificate in February 2025. The state directory lists Fire Official Fredrick J Dressel IV at (201) 440-1815.

other_items.label: Zoning permit
other_items.detail: A Zoning Permit is required for every home sale: $25 owner occupied, $75 non-owner occupied.
